blockers.claim: The ordering-constraint band (A) d_fix ∈ [0.1mm, 5.0mm] ADMITS the D362 push-over exemplar (fixed jaw 4.27mm), directly contradicting the design's own justification sentence 'D362 밀어넘김은 A 위반 자세(fixed 4.27mm 이격)에서 발생 — 재정식화가 원 의도 보존'. 4.27mm lies inside [0.1, 5.0], so A∧B would score the only known push-over failure geometry as ordering-constraint PASS, giving the constraint zero demonstrated screening power while the doc claims the opposite.
blockers.evidence: Design: claudedocs/session_20260803_grasp_g0a_d409_sweep_recovery_design_v1.md:131-140 (band [0.1,5.0] at :132-134; 'A 위반 자세(fixed 4.27mm)' at :138-139). The 4.27mm value is real and q5-invariant: claudedocs/runtime_logs/grasp_track/g0a_d354/d354_q5_closure_sweep.csv row 0 raw_link5_mm=4.2726455336106985 (single unique value across all 33 anchors, verified by column sort -u) and live_link5_mm=4.272736580324082 == D371 stored distance (claudedocs/runtime_logs/grasp_track/g0a_d371/d371_offline_collider_comparison_evidence.json, grep-verified). blockers.proposed_fix: Before freeze, recompute d_fix at the frozen (7,11) pose under the design's exact metric (hppfcl min over link5 inner-mask 4 parts) and set the (A) gate upper bound strictly below that value (e.g., gate on the proximal band ≤1mm already defined in §2.7, keeping ≤5mm as a recorded diagnostic band only), OR keep [0.1,5.0] but delete/correct the intent-preservation sentence and state explicitly in prereg that A∧B does not exclude the D362 failure exemplar.

blockers.claim: The τ domain [9,000–14,000µm] is inherited unchanged on the claim '조(jaw) 측 기하 유래 — 원통 반경 비결부', but the fixed-jaw gap is provably radius-coupled with ∂gap/∂R = −1: the D330 gap formula subtracts obj_radius_m directly, so shrinking R from 17mm to 14.5mm shifts d_fix by +2.5mm at identical (ρ,τ). The A-satisfying τ band therefore shifts down by 2.5mm and the inherited window truncates most of it (planar estimate: band ≈[6.0,10.9]mm, covered only [9,10.9]; frozen-pose 4.27mm@τ=11 estimate: band ≈[4.3,9.2]mm, covered only [9,9.2]). An '전수' region map computed on this window systematically misses the majority of the fixed-jaw-proximal region, biasing the region components and ρ_R that are the case's primary deliverable.
blockers.evidence: Design assertion: claudedocs/session_20260803_grasp_g0a_d409_sweep_recovery_design_v1.md:104-108. Radius coupling: sim_scripts/cyl34_top_view_d330_grasp_g0a_alignment_probe.py:230-231 (cylinder_side_plane = obj_center − tangent*obj_radius_m; signed_gap projects onto tangent). Jaw constant is ~8mm: sim_scripts/cube10cm_top_view_d323_grasp_g0a_frame_repair_probe.py:38 (FIXED_JAW_FACE_LOCAL_M=[-0.008,0,0]) with link5_x used as tangent reference at d330:226-228. Empirical anchor: g0a_d330_cyl_alignment_trials.csv near-cluster trials at τ=11mm/R=17mm give fixed_jaw_face_gap_mm 2.42–2.99 → effective constant ≈ −8.5mm; old domain [9,14] maps to old gap band [0.6,5.6]mm ≈ the old 0–5mm gate, confirming the old τ window was fitted to R=17. For barrel-adjacent witness the design's own hppfcl metric shifts exactly by −ΔR (distance = ||p−axis||_xy − R). Note the design DID rebase the radial axis for the same reason (17,000→14,500µm, '14.5mm−r', v1 doc :50-52) but declined for τ.
blockers.proposed_fix: Rebase the τ domain with the radius change (shift by −2,500µm, e.g., τ ∈ {6,500,…,11,500}µm, or widen to {4,000,…,14,000}µm keeping 250µm pitch), derive the window from the jaw constant + new R in prereg, and add an edge-touch fail-flag: any admitted 4-connected component touching the τ (or ρ) domain boundary invalidates the 'exhaustive region' claim for that component.
